searchText: > FWIW I implemented this `index=1,2,3`, without considering the alternative. <@!361447803194441738> i've allowed both in teku, basically by implementing that, then joining all of the entries in the query parameter array by comma first 🙂 just worth being aware of the permutations i guess still on getAttesterDuties, (ref https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Validator/getAttesterDuties) none of the fields are marked nullable, but my guess is the expectation of a validator that's exited would be you'll get the pubkey, then all nulls?
